goal: Support the complete automatic proposal stage on exact OpenAI and Anthropic models with approved v2 requests and durable reservation admission.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Support native OpenAI gpt-5.6-terra and Anthropic claude-sonnet-5 requests without fallback or workspace/tool access, retaining explicit DeepSeek support.
Exercise recorded failures through clustering, approval-bound generation and schema-valid persisted drafts with mocked native providers.
Reserve approved allocation durably before sending and deny duplicate, over-limit, drifted or malformed admissions.
Pass the complete repository gate with reviewed source capsule pins.

outcome.summary: Automatic multi-provider proposal tests and all implementation checks pass. Full closure is blocked by the changed spec and roadmap capsule pins.

exception.reason: Two capsule source digests need review after the v2 provider and budget contract change.
exception.next_action: Review the multi-provider proposal contract, authorize source-pin refresh, and rerun the full gate. Paid DSH rollouts remain separately gated.

what_worked: Both requested providers complete the automatic proposal flow through native-wire mocked transports.
Reasoning output is excluded from the persisted OpenAI proposal; tools and incomplete outputs are rejected.
Reservations persist across success, failure and unknown outcomes; duplicate sends are denied.
what_failed: The first plugin check used an outdated built CLI; rebuilding resolved the missing budget option.
Initial OpenAI parsing rejected valid reasoning-plus-message responses; focused positive and negative controls now cover them.
Full verification stops at the expected source-pin review gate.

calls.name: vitest
calls.purpose: Verify transport, budget, automatic proposal and CLI/workbench paths offline.

failures_and_inefficiencies.summary: Source-bound capsule review remains necessary for final closure.
failures_and_inefficiencies.suggested_action: Review the v2 provider and reservation contract before refreshing pins.

evidence.summary: 222 tests pass for provider-specific wire formats, exact models, v2 schema, request integrity, selected credentials, timeouts, byte limits, reasoning envelopes and rejected tools/refusals.
24 tests pass for exact-model automatic proposal generation with mocked native fetch and no runner override; approval and budget failures precede transport.

44 tests pass for concurrent admissions, durable reservations, repeated digests, cap drift, provider separation and ledger corruption. Allocation accounting is not provider billing or DSH-wide spend enforcement.

Typecheck/build pass; 577 tests pass, seven skip and one capsule test fails. Changed sources: spec in contract capsule and roadmap in adapter capsule. Later chained gates did not run. Final code review and diff whitespace checks pass.

notes: The user requested automatic proposal support for both exact models. Final changed-contract and source-pin review is pending. No live model call, actual credential inspection, installation, activation, commit or push was performed.
